scope: Panel notifier provider binding, ABI adaptation, and candidate static build evidence for zte_tpd.

provider_semantics.current_docker_provider: Trigger invokes callbacks while holding panel_client_mutex. Unregister takes the same mutex to remove the client, so unregister waits for any in-flight callback to finish before returning.
provider_semantics.stock_external_provider_behavior: The stock external notifier releases its registry mutex before invoking copied callbacks and does not drain them during unregister. This is a separate provider and is not the provider resolved by this Docker kernel build.

actions: Register with the current target enum and primary-touch client type.
Filter notifications against the active panel pointer.
Translate the target notification into the legacy 16-byte callback view before calling the unchanged stock callback.
Treat ERR_PTR and NULL registration results as failure.
Remove the manually declared external panel_event_notifier module dependency; the target exports these symbols from vmlinux.

registration.reason: The target ABI adaptation and registration failure guard change this function from stock.

limitations: No module load, boot, runtime race test, fault injection, or NX809J hardware validation was performed.
The result is bound to the recorded Docker kernel source, configuration, KMI, and built-in provider.
packaging_note: Do not ship or load reference_modules/full_vendor_boot/panel_event_notifier.ko with this built-in-provider kernel; its ABI/KMI is different.
